When to Call for Gas Line Repairs

You should call for help with a suspected gas problem immediately! A gas leak is an emergency every time. Older lines can develop leaks, experience pressure problems, or become damaged due to environmental conditions or wear and tear. Recognizing the signs of trouble early can help prevent more significant issues.

Some of the earliest warning signs of a gas issue include the odor of rotten eggs, which is added to natural gas to make it easier to detect. Visible damage to your gas line, such as corrosion, dents, or cracks. Another sign of a possible gas issue is appliance performance that goes wonky. If your gas stove suddenly takes too long to heat up or heats up in moments, it could indicate a pressure problem.
